tutorial.name: The Lost Lanterns of Greymoor
tutorial.summary: An original short adventure for first-time D&D players: read a character sheet, investigate, talk to an NPC, finish a first combat, and make a recorded ending choice.

mistbound_road.title: A Light Out in the Mist
mistbound_road.narration: The Greymoor road lantern is cold ash. A wagon leans in the mud while thin fog swallows the road ahead.
mistbound_road.objective: Observe the scene. There is no single correct answer; choose what feels natural for your character.
mistbound_road.hint: You can inspect the ash or begin with the wagon tracks. Both choices reveal a useful clue.

keepers_plea.title: Mira the Lantern Keeper
keepers_plea.narration: Young keeper Mira runs from a roadside cottage. She fears both the lantern core and her mentor, who checked the old shrine last night, are missing.
keepers_plea.objective: Try a social choice: reassure her, or ask for precise facts first.
keepers_plea.hint: Social play is not about guessing exact words. State your goal, then choose an approach that fits your character.

read_the_trail.title: Two Good Trails
read_the_trail.narration: Small three-toed prints mark the mud. A faint glow matching the lantern lingers among the roots. Both trails lead toward Thorn Glade.
read_the_trail.objective: Choose a tracking method and see how different strengths can reach the same goal.
read_the_trail.hint: You may attempt an action without the ideal skill. Training changes confidence, not permission.

thorn_ambush.title: Your First Encounter
thorn_ambush.narration: A goblin minion is prying at the shrine stones. It spots you. Start First Skirmish in the combat panel, then finish or end the encounter to continue.
thorn_ambush.objective: Learn initiative, movement, attacks, actions, and ending a turn. This step unlocks when combat ends.
thorn_ambush.hint: The target begins 25 feet away. A melee hero can move first; a ranged hero can choose a suitable weapon. Failure does not end the adventure.

restore_the_lantern.title: The Truth Beneath the Shrine
restore_the_lantern.narration: A brass key opens the lantern box. Mira's mentor diverted its light to seal a dangerous rift, but vanished before explaining why. You can return only the light, or return with the full truth.
restore_the_lantern.objective: Choose an ending. The system will record the result, complete the task, and create a chapter summary.
restore_the_lantern.hint: There is no official best answer. Decide whether your character values immediate safety, trust, or informed choice most.

inspect_cold_ash.label: Inspect the cold ash
inspect_cold_ash.description: Learn why an ordinary flame did not simply burn out.

check_wagon_tracks.label: Check the wagon tracks
check_wagon_tracks.description: Establish what moved through the scene.

reassure_mira.label: Reassure Mira first
reassure_mira.description: Promise to return with news of her mentor and the lantern.

ask_precise_questions.label: Ask precise questions
ask_precise_questions.description: Confirm the time, route, and unusual signs.

follow_small_tracks.label: Follow the small tracks
follow_small_tracks.description: Read the ground through the glade.

secure_the_glade.label: Secure and search the glade
secure_the_glade.description: Inspect the shrine after the encounter.

return_the_light.label: Return the light first
return_the_light.description: Make the road safe again as quickly as possible.

share_the_truth.label: Return the light and the truth
share_the_truth.description: Tell Mira about the mentor's choice and the rift.

clue:cold_silver_ash.title: Cold Silver Ash
clue:cold_silver_ash.summary: The ash has no warmth, as if light was drawn out of the wick.

clue:three_toed_tracks.title: Three-Toed Tracks
clue:three_toed_tracks.summary: Tracks from a small humanoid lead from the wagon toward Thorn Glade.

relationship:mira_trust.title: Mira's Trust
relationship:mira_trust.summary: Mira believes the adventurers will take her mentor's disappearance seriously.

task:recover_way_lantern.title: Recover the Way Lantern
task:recover_way_lantern.summary: Discover why the lantern failed and what happened to its keeper.

fact:lantern_failed_at_midnight.title: Midnight Failure
fact:lantern_failed_at_midnight.summary: Mira confirms every light failed at midnight and her mentor went to the old shrine.

clue:thorn_glade_route.title: Route to Thorn Glade
clue:thorn_glade_route.summary: The tracks avoid the bog and end at the old shrine's glade.

clue:lantern_resonance.title: Lantern Resonance
clue:lantern_resonance.summary: The fading glow resonates with the old shrine deep in the glade.

item:brass_shrine_key.title: Brass Shrine Key
item:brass_shrine_key.summary: An old key from the glade opens the lantern box beneath the shrine.

fact:greymoor_light_restored.title: Greymoor's Light Restored
fact:greymoor_light_restored.summary: The lantern's power returned to the road and made night travel safe.

fact:shrine_truth_shared.title: The Shrine Truth Shared
fact:shrine_truth_shared.summary: Mira learned why her mentor used the lantern to seal the rift.
